title: Anastasia Labs X Maestro - Plug ‘n Play 2.0

ms.promise:
Develop and implement the following contracts
・upgradable multisignature (multisig) smart contract using Plutus that enables authorized members to execute asset transactions within predefined thresholds. This contract should demonstrate secure spending of assets, seamless adjustment of signer thresholds, and dynamic addition or removal of signers for enduring usability
・Develop a subscription payments smart contract using Plutus which enables users to effortlessly manage recurring payments directly from their wallets
ms.criteria:
Acceptance Criteria for Upgradable Multisignature Smart Contract:
・Secure Spending of Assets: Demonstration of the smart contract ensuring that asset transactions can only be executed by authorized members.
・Seamless Adjustment of Signer Thresholds: Demonstration of implementation of functionality allowing authorized members to adjust signer thresholds without compromising security.
・Dynamic Addition or Removal of Signers: Showcase of smart contract's capability to add or remove signers dynamically as needed.
